title: Sparkly lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow behind bolt -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='32' fill='#3a2a0a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Lightning bolt main shape -->
  <polygon points='56,8 32,52 46,52 40,92 70,42 54,42 62,8' fill='#FFD93D' stroke='#FFB800' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Bolt highlight -->
  <polygon points='53,16 38,48 47,48 43,74 62,44 52,44 58,16' fill='#FFF4A3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Sparkle 1 top-left -->
  <g transform='translate(24,22)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-7' x2='0' y2='7' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-7' y1='0' x2='7' y2='0' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4.5' y1='-4.5' x2='4.5' y2='4.5' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4.5' y1='-4.5' x2='-4.5' y2='4.5' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 top-right -->
  <g transform='translate(76,18)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='-3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 bottom-left -->
  <g transform='translate(20,74)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 bottom-right -->
  <g transform='translate(80,78)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='-3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='28' r='2.5' fill='#FFE566'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='38' r='2' fill='#FFE566'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='62' r='2' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#FFE566'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='82' r='2' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='88' r='2' fill='#FFE566'/>
</svg>
